Notes: groomer control 1 was rerun: on its first attempt the model answered the bench's mapping question with no visible text, twice, so nothing was measured. That is the bench's question failing, not the agent's app. The first attempt deployed as groomer-r1-1; the rerun deploys as groomer-r1-1-a2.
The round was paused once between runs to fix that; the lending carlos 1 run it interrupted had only read documentation, and was rerun from the start.

lending control 1 and 2 and noticeboard control 2 were rerun after two bench faults: the mapping question, asked with no tools, came back empty three times running in two sessions; and a signed-in page with a #fragment on the URL sign-in had landed on was never reloaded, so nothing was measured. Both fixed in the bench; the reruns deploy under -a2 names.

lending control 2 was rerun a second time: its admin page has a password field for adding a member, and the bench judged sign-in by whether a password field was still in sight, so a working sign-in read as a failed one. Sign-in is now judged by the URL leaving the sign-in page; the rerun deploys as -a3.
